The proposal will distinguish evaluated sections from areas needing further access rather than assume the entire spread is known.

sections.title: Make material decisions along the affected route
sections.text: Insulation, debris, and retained building surfaces may need different handling. We will identify unsuitable material for removal and cleaning appropriate to the surfaces that can stay. Extracting wastewater will be recorded as one stage, not a complete answer to every exposed material.

sections.title: Explain remaining moisture and source requirements
sections.text: The drain correction belongs with the plumbing provider. We will identify related drying and any unresolved access limitation after cleanup. Replacement materials should follow those findings, with completion described for the sections actually addressed rather than the entire unseen crawl space.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/coyote-flats.estimate: Distribution, clearance, affected materials, and disposal needs determine the estimate. Share the plumbing diagnosis and locations where wastewater was reported by a provider.
